router = APIRouter(prefix="/_dev/mock-gateways")

class GatewayTogglePayload(BaseModel):
    mock_enabled: bool

@router.post("/{gateway_id}/toggle")
async def toggle_mock_gateway(
    gateway_id: str,
    payload: GatewayTogglePayload,
    current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    switchboard: MockSwitchboard = Depends(get_mock_switchboard)
):
    gateway_config = await switchboard.get_gateway_config(gateway_id=gateway_id)
    if not gateway_config:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Gateway configuration not found")

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException
from pydantic import BaseModel

router = APIRouter(prefix="/_dev/mock-gateways")

class GatewayTogglePayload(BaseModel):
    mock_enabled: bool

@router.post("/{gateway_id}/toggle")
async def toggle_mock_gateway(
    gateway_id: str,
    payload: GatewayTogglePayload,
    current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    switchboard: MockSwitchboard = Depends(get_mock_switchboard)
):
    gateway_config = await switchboard.get_gateway_config(gateway_id=gateway_id)
    if not gateway_config or gateway_config.org_id != current_user.organization_id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Gateway configuration not found")

    await switchboard.set_mock_state(gateway_id=gateway_id, enabled=payload.mock_enabled)
    return {
        "gateway_id": gateway_id,
        "mock_enabled": payload.mock_enabled,
        "provider": gateway_config.provider
    }
